[EVENT] User is thinking of getting a gift for a coworker who is leaving soon.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Personalized item (mug, pen, plaque)

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Experience gift (tickets to events or activities)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Memory book or scrapbook  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Practical item (bag, notecards, portable charger)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Gift card to a favorite store or restaurant  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of a personalized item for the coworker's gift.  
[EVENT] User asks if a customized coffee mug would be a good choice.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that a customized coffee mug can be both functional and a keepsake, providing scenarios for each.  
[PREFERENCE] User decides on a design that is a mix of both functional and sentimental.
